# SelfRespawn

`world-system`

Any player may kill their own character to respawn at their bed or the world spawn, with the normal death rules, from a command or a menu button, so no one can be trapped inside another's structure.

> A way out of any wall (DurabilityAndDestruction, Phase 203)
